proposedChanges.change: Add pretinted disabled check for dark mode
proposedChanges.reason: MR head uses #767676 on the dark disabled surface (#313134), 2.85:1. The new value is 5.85:1 and matches the disabled foreground token. Geometry is unchanged from check.svg.
Theme registry consistency; generated CSS data URI verified to match the source SVG.

proposedChanges.change: Use the new pretint only in .dark-mode for checked+disabled checkboxes
proposedChanges.reason: Keeps light-mode output unchanged while restoring >=3:1 in dark mode.
Covers asset validity, token registration, compiled/source parity, dark rule, and contrast.

knownLimitations: Whole-core literal searches and dynamic-path inspection cannot prove an asset is never used; absence is evidence, not proof (see AGENTS.md).

The live Drupal 12 lab site was tested with the MR checkmark files and CSS applied surgically to the baseline default_admin theme; the full MR theme was not installed, and the lab core revision is d29add7e rather than MR head fe4adb4.
Forced-colours results use Chromium media emulation, not native Windows High Contrast. Native Windows verification remains outstanding.
Only the checkmark family was reconciled; 181 assets from the wider inventory remain pending.
Reduced motion and RTL are not applicable to the non-directional check glyph; RTL toggle positioning is unchanged.
Automated pixel/contrast checks do not establish WCAG conformance.

liveIntegration.component: 91 disabled+checked checkboxes in the Administrator permission column
liveIntegration.method: MR checkmark assets/CSS applied to the baseline theme; caches rebuilt; proposed fix added; baseline theme restored exactly.
